## Subjective

22yo F, no PMH, presents with 2 days of bilateral red eyes with watery discharge (location: bilateral eyes; quality: itchy, watery; duration: 2 days; timing: morning crusting). Denies vision changes, eye pain, photophobia, contact lens use. Sister had similar sx last week. Tobacco: never.

## Objective

VS: BP 116/74, HR 76. Gen: NAD. Eyes: mild bilateral conjunctival injection, watery discharge, no purulent discharge, no preauricular adenopathy, vision intact b/l, EOMI. HEENT: TMs clear, oropharynx unremarkable.

## Assessment

1. Acute viral conjunctivitis (H10.32)

## Plan

Symptomatic care: cool compresses, artificial tears OTC PRN. Hand hygiene reinforced — avoid sharing towels/pillows. Self-limited, expect resolution in 7-14 days. Return for: vision changes, severe pain, purulent discharge, photophobia, or symptoms persisting >2 weeks. No school/work restriction beyond hand hygiene precautions.
